**Job Description Summary

**As a Lead System Designer, you will provide technical leadership across the full product lifecycle, ensuring that product designs meet customer needs, business objectives, quality expectations, and regulatory requirements. You will lead technical decision-making within cross-functional teams and support the integration of requirements, risk management, verification, validation, and design transfer activities.

You will lead technical reviews, drive resolution of technical issues, and help teams make informed technical decisions while balancing performance, quality, schedule, and regulatory requirements.

For this role, you must be eligible to work in Denmark and on-site our facilities in Herlev, near Copenhagen.

**Job Description

**GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Essential Responsibilities

**

• Provide technical leadership within NPI and sustaining engineering programs throughout the product lifecycle.

• Serve as the technical lead within cross-functional teams, guiding technical decisions and product design direction.

• Review and approve product requirements are complete, feasible, testable, and aligned with customer and business needs.

• Accountable for development of system requirements and related Design Control deliverables.

• Define and drive Design Verification and Design Validation strategies.

• Lead Technical Design Reviews and resolution of technical issues.

• Lead defect management, technical investigations, and problem solving.

• Review and support risk assessments and FMEA activities, drive FMEA strategy ensuring effective integration of risk controls into product requirements, verification, and validation.

• Ensure traceability between customer needs, requirements, risks, verification and validation evidence.

• Support Design Transfer and technical knowledge transfer to manufacturing and service organizations.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Relevant Engineering degree.

• Significant experience in Systems Engineering, Product Development, or Technical Leadership within medical devices or another regulated industry.

• Strong understanding of Design Control, Risk Management, Verification, Validation, and Change Control.

• Experience leading complex product development activities across multiple engineering disciplines.

• Extensive experience working across software, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, service, clinical, and quality functions.

• Extensive experience developing requirements, specifications, verification strategies, and technical documentation.

• Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across cross-functional teams.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills.

**Behaviors

**We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards

**Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

**Inclusion & Diversity

**GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

**Join Our Team as a Quality Control Manager

**We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Manager to lead and develop our incoming quality control activities. This is a key role within our organization, ensuring that incoming materials and components meet quality requirements while supporting continuous improvement across our operations.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining product quality, driving process improvements, and supporting production through strong quality leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Incoming Quality Control

**

• Take overall responsibility for Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities.

• Ensure all incoming materials, components, and products comply with established quality requirements and specifications.

• Investigate and manage supplier-related quality issues and non-conformances.

• Work closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to resolve quality concerns.

**Process Development and Improvement

**

• Lead the implementation of new procedures and standards for incoming inspection processes.

• Continuously improve inspection methods, quality controls, and efficiency.

• Develop and maintain inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and quality documentation.

• Support supplier qualification and supplier quality improvement initiatives.

**Quality Documentation

**

• Own and maintain controlled documents related to Quality Control activities.

• Ensure procedures, work instructions, forms, and records are current, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and internal requirements.

• Support internal and external audits as required.

**Team Leadership

**

• Directly manage and develop one QC Technician.

• Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching, and support employee development.

• Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Operational Support

**

• Participate in daily production meetings and provide quality-related input.

• Collaborate with production teams to address quality concerns and minimize disruptions.

• Support root cause investigations and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.

• Monitor quality performance and drive actions to improve product and process quality.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, or Manufacturing Quality.

• Previous leadership experience is preferred.

• Experience with incoming inspection processes and supplier quality management.

• Familiarity with ISO 9001 and other relevant quality management systems.

• Strong knowledge of incoming inspection methodologies, AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) sampling plans, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality management software systems.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**Personal Competencies

**We are looking for a candidate who is:

• Structured and detail-oriented.

• Proactive and solution-focused.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• A strong communicator with excellent collaboration skills.

• Results driven with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Capable of balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational responsibilities.

**What We Offer

**

• An exciting opportunity to shape and improve our quality processes.

• A collaborative and professional working environment.

• Opportunities for personal and professional development.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• The chance to make a significant impact on product quality and operational excellence.

jobs.description:
This is a consulting role with customer assignments across Denmark. You can be based anywhere in Denmark, provided you can work regularly on-site with customers, primarily in Greater Copenhagen, the Kolding/Fredericia area, and Central Jutland.

As a Senior OT/IT Network & Infrastructure Architect at Opoura, you will work as a consultant in customer environments where experienced technical judgment is needed. You will typically take responsibility for complex OT/IT infrastructure challenges that span architecture, implementation, and transition into reliable operations.

When a suitable assignment is confirmed, you will join Opoura in a permanent position and work primarily with the customer, usually on assignments lasting 6-12 months or longer.

We are currently seeing increasing demand for this level of expertise and already have active customer needs and concrete opportunities where relevant Architects may come into consideration. We are therefore building a talent pool of experienced profiles so we can move quickly when there is a strong match between a customer need and your background.

This is not a vacancy tied to one specific customer or immediate start date. The opportunity depends on the right assignment, but when the match is there, the process can move quickly.

Your role

You will join OT Solutions within Opoura’s Digital Services Business Unit and work closely with customer specialists, operations teams, suppliers, engineers, and other technical stakeholders.

Most assignments will place you directly within an existing customer environment. That means understanding the infrastructure already in place, identifying what needs to change, and helping the customer make technical decisions that work not only on paper, but also in implementation and day-to-day operations.

The role is deliberately broad enough for you to work across architecture and technical detail. You might be defining an infrastructure design, reviewing network segmentation, resolving gaps before operational handover, or helping improve the way recurring infrastructure activities are standardized and automated.

You will report to Kent Weiling, OT Solutions Manager, who will remain your direct manager and point of contact for sparring and alignment.

Our customers within this area are currently concentrated in Greater Copenhagen, the Triangle Region and Central Jutland. You should expect to work at the customer site around 2-3 days per week, depending on the assignment, combined with remote work and occasional time at Opoura’s headquarters in Silkeborg. International travel is not expected.

Your main responsibilities

Depending on the customer assignment, you will:

• Own OT/IT network and infrastructure solutions from technical assessment and architecture through implementation and operational handover.

• Design, assess, and troubleshoot industrial networks, including routing, switching, VLANs, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, remote access, and site connectivity.

• Drive technical site intake and operational readiness, including documentation, access, monitoring, ownership, maintainability, and closure of identified gaps.

• Contribute senior expertise during implementation, commissioning, migrations, and complex root-cause analysis together with customer teams, suppliers, and operations.

• Improve lifecycle management, standardization, and automation through reusable designs, Infrastructure as Code, source-of-truth data, templates, and automated validation where relevant.

To be successful in this position, you

Understand complex existing environments quickly and distinguish between what needs to change and what can remain.

• Move comfortably between architecture-level decisions and configuration-level detail.

• Build credibility with customers through clear reasoning, dependable delivery, and direct technical communication.

• Challenge assumptions constructively and turn unclear technical issues into practical decisions and next steps.

• Work independently without losing alignment with the wider customer organization or Opoura.

• Apply standards where they add value while remaining pragmatic when the environment calls for a different approach.

Your background

This is a role for an experienced Architect who can contribute at senior level from the outset. We are not looking for one narrowly defined CV, and you do not need equal depth across every technology area.

We expect that you bring several of the following:

• Significant experience within network and infrastructure engineering or architecture, combined with substantial exposure to OT, SCADA, industrial systems, or other operational environments.

• Experience taking infrastructure from assessment and design through implementation, handover, or operations.

• Strong industrial networking knowledge across areas such as routing, switching, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, remote connectivity, and multi-site environments.

• Experience with infrastructure platforms and core services such as Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, virtualization, storage, backup, and recovery.

• A practical understanding of secure and resilient OT infrastructure, including controlled access, hardening, maintainability, and lifecycle considerations.

• Experience with automation or Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, Git-based CI/CD, APIs, or source-of-truth platforms is an advantage.

Professional fluency in English is required. Danish or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from wind, renewable energy, utilities, manufacturing, process industries, transport, system integration, or other critical infrastructure can all be relevant. Experience with technical site intake and transition to operations is particularly valuable.

About Opoura

Opoura is a Danish renewable energy technology company with teams across Europe and the US. We develop software, SCADA, control, and OT solutions that help energy companies manage and optimize renewable energy assets such as wind farms, solar plants, and battery systems.

Within Digital Services, OT Solutions works with secure, reliable, and maintainable infrastructure for energy, utilities, and other critical-infrastructure customers.

What we offer

For an experienced Architect, the value of this role is the combination of technical depth, variation, and continuity.

You can expect:

• Longer assignments that give you time to understand the environment, shape the solution, and see the outcome of your decisions.

• Customer situations where you are brought in for your experience and judgment, not simply to execute a predefined task list.

• Exposure to different OT and infrastructure environments over time, while maintaining the continuity of permanent employment with Opoura.

• The opportunity to work across architecture and practical delivery rather than being confined to one narrow layer of the technology stack.

• Scope to improve standards, automation, lifecycle practices, and delivery methods where your experience can make the work more robust and repeatable.

• Flexibility between customer-site work, remote work, and occasional time with Opoura in Silkeborg, within the needs of each assignment.

How to apply

This posting is used to build our talent pool for current and upcoming customer needs and does not represent one immediately available position.

We assess profiles on an ongoing basis. Because hiring depends on the timing and confirmation of customer assignments, there may be a period before you hear from us.

When we identify a potential match, we will contact you to discuss the assignment, location, timing, and your interest. The process will typically include direct dialogue with the customer before the assignment is contracted. Once an assignment is confirmed, the process toward permanent employment with Opoura can move quickly.

To be considered, please fill out the application form and upload your CV. We look forward to receiving your application.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Are you a senior programme professional with deep contextual understanding, strong strategic judgement and the ability to build trusted relationships in complex settings? Do you combine programme leadership with donor engagement, resource mobilisation and a commitment to rights-based, locally led change? Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke (MS) is looking for a Senior Programme Manager to lead and further develop our engagement in Syria and Lebanon.

About the role

You will be MS’s key focal point for a portfolio of three to four Danida-funded country programmes, including MS’s engagement with youth driven partners in Syria and Lebanon. You will hold responsibility for programme quality, strategic development and resource mobilisation across the portfolio. Working across MS and the wider ActionAid federation, you will turn contextual insight and strong partnerships into effective programmes and new funding opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

• Lead MS’s programme engagement and partner dialogue in Syria and Lebanon within the wider Danida-funded portfolio.

• Lead programme planning, implementation, monitoring, learning and adaptation with partners and ActionAid teams.

• Ensure sound grant and financial management, including budgets, risks, disbursements and donor reporting.

• Lead donor engagement, fundraising and the development of new proposals.

• Turn regional political, economic and social developments into strategic advice and programme decisions making sure, that young people are involved and included.

• Represent MS in relevant donor, policy and coordination forums and contribute to advocacy and communications.

Required qualifications

• At least six years’ experience in programme and project cycle management, including five years in a low- or middle-income country and experience from an NGO, civil society organisation or similar setting.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes and building trusted partnerships across cultures and locations.

• Strong grant and financial management skills, including budgeting, risk management and narrative and financial reporting.

• Experience with institutional donors and developing high-quality proposals and reports, including for Danida or the EU.

• Strong analytical, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn strategy into action.

• Fluency in Danish and English and willingness to travel internationally for five to six weeks per year.

Desired qualifications

• Direct professional experience from Syria or Lebanon is highly desirable; substantial experience from the wider MENA region will also be considered.

• Professional working proficiency in Arabic.

• Experience with rights-based, locally led programming and the humanitarian–development nexus.

• Experience with young people, social movements, youth activism or campaigning.

Working at MS

You will join an informal, mission-driven workplace with committed colleagues, professional sparring and room to use your expertise. We offer flexible working hours, the possibility of working from home, professional development, paid leave between Christmas and New Year and a vegetarian lunch scheme.

Location and employment terms

The position is full-time and based at MS’s office at Fælledvej 12 in Copenhagen. It is a two-year fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, with preferred start in 1 January 2027 or alternatively, 1 February 2027. You will join the International Programme and Partnerships team and report to Lisbeth Petersen, International Director for Programme & Partnerships. The role involves approximately five to six weeks of international travel per year. Salary and employment conditions follow the Danish collective agreement and the applicable AC agreement.

How to apply

Apply through our online recruitment system with your CV and a short motivation letter by Tuesday 10th November 2026, at 23:59 CET. First-round interviews will be held in week 48 & second-round in week 49. Questions can be directed to Lisbeth Petersen, International Director for Programme & Partnerships, at lpe@ms.dk.

About Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke

Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke (MS) works in Denmark and internationally to challenge inequality and strengthen people’s ability to claim their rights and shape their communities. MS is the Danish member of the international ActionAid federation.

We are committed to diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background, identity or personal circumstances.

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

**Job Description

**

Our team are recognised as global experts in the development and deployment of BIM on major projects and programmes, delivering client outcomes which mutually benefit the supply chain and add value to projects.

The approach underpinning our delivery is:

• 
Forward thinking

• 
Careful planning

• 
Shared understanding

• 
Transparency and collaboration

• 
Independent and open methodology

We work holistically with our wider business to provide an environment for innovation and deliver success on projects where BIM is core to the delivery and operation of assets.

We lead the BIM process at organisational, programme and project level through:

• 
Discovery and understanding

• 
Client adoption strategy and strategic project setup

• 
Project and programme BIM execution planning

• 
BIM implementation, information management and supply chain management

• 
BIM compliance checking and data verification

Our specialist staff work globally, using cutting edge tools and techniques to deliver the vision of the world’s best clients.

**Job summary

**

Turner & Townsend Digital Europe are looking for an exceptional Senior Consultant to join our growing team. The successful applicant will help implement BIM on behalf of our clients across Europe; co-managing the BIM team, taking on line management duties and being responsible for project delivery. The role is to be based close to Fredericia, Denmark working on a Datacenter project.

**Specific duties

**

• 
Leading and supporting our team in the implementation of BIM on major projects, programmes and across portfolios.

• 
Authoring of key BIM documentation such as Asset Information Requirements, Employer Information Requirements and where applicable, BIM Execution Plans.

• 
Assessing project teams BIM competency, advising the development of the project BIM Execution Plans and approving on behalf of Client where necessary.

• 
Assure project BIM standards are being followed by project stakeholders reporting key risks and effective mitigations.

• 
Lead model assurance activities including; definition of strategy and approach, model analysis, technical and plain language reporting.

• 
Chair and lead BIM workgroup and Technical BIM sessions with the project team to present outcomes of model assurance activities.

• 
Research, develop and implement areas of new technology, process and emerging best practices.

• 
Continuingly develop in-house standards and capabilities.

• 
Provide support to the wider business with tender bidding teams to win future work.

**Qualifications

**

Typically, a qualified professional in a relevant discipline, five or more year’s relevant experience in a BIM environment is a key component of the role. The applicant should be familiar with ISO 19650 and other relevant local standards/guidelines. We are looking for someone to be an enthusiastic, proactive self-starters with well-developed communications and analytical skills.

Previous experience working in a BIM environment on a major project, programme or across a large portfolio would be ideal, evidence of BIM courses and modules would strengthen your application. Expected to be numerate and computer literate, competent in at least one of the following ‘model checking’ and ‘model authoring’ software’s:

• 
Solibri Model Checker

• 
Autodesk Navisworks

• 
Graphisoft ArchiCAD

• 
Bentley AECOsim

• 
Nemetschek Vectorworks

• 
Autodesk Revit

• 
Autodesk Construction Cloud/360

• 
You will work with us to develop your technical and management skills through project experience, training and mentorship.

**Core competencies

**

• 
Enthusiastic and positive team player - Giving the project team confidence in the use of BIM

• 
Excellent Communicator – ability to provide clear guidance to the whole project team, in order to coordinate a successful outcome

• 
Experience in writing clear, concise requirements and documentation.

• 
Have an understanding of design, BIM and procurement, and its application in planning and construction management

• 
Have an understanding of BIM Competency Assessments of supply chains

• 
Proven systematic approach to problem solving and model development protocols

• 
Proven experience in multidisciplinary working practices and interdependencies

• 
Proven client facing experience

• 
Up to date knowledge of BIM technology and interoperability standards / good all round technical knowledge and enthusiasm.

Our people share our Purpose and Values. Turner & Townsend provides a great place to work, where everyone can make change happen and influence a better world.

At Autorola Solutions, we're helping transform how the global automotive industry operates through digital solutions, technology and business process expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Business System Consultant to take a leading role in designing and delivering complex software solutions across customer engagements. Combining strong business process understanding with deep solution expertise, you'll translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality system solutions and take ownership of the technical approach from initial analysis through configuration, implementation and final validation.

As a senior member of the team, you'll be a trusted advisor to customers and an important sparring partner for Project Management Consultants, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries. You'll help shape solution designs, guide technical decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that customer needs are translated into practical, sustainable solutions that create lasting business value.

If you're passionate about solving complex business challenges, advising customers at a strategic and operational level, and driving high-quality software implementations, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us

**The Autorola Group is a global leader in online vehicle remarketing, automotive IT solutions and business intelligence for the used vehicle market. Through Autorola Marketplace, Autorola Solutions and Indicata, we help manufacturers, leasing companies, fleet owners and dealers buy, sell and manage vehicles more efficiently using technology, data and digital solutions.

**Lead the design and delivery of smart, scalable solutions

**As Senior Business System Consultant, you'll take ownership of the technical solution throughout the customer engagement. Working in close partnership with a Project Management Consultant, who is responsible for the client relationship, project scope, planning and overall delivery, you'll lead the solution design and ensure that business requirements are translated into robust, scalable and maintainable system solutions.

You'll bring senior-level expertise to complex customer scenarios, advising on business processes, product capabilities and solution alternatives. You'll challenge requirements where appropriate, identify opportunities to leverage standard functionality, and help determine when configuration is sufficient and when further product development is needed.

Your role will extend beyond individual implementations. You'll contribute to improving our solution delivery practices, establish and promote best practices, share knowledge across the team and act as a trusted technical and functional sparring partner for colleagues. Where relevant, you'll also engage directly with customer business teams to ensure that solutions support real operational workflows and deliver the intended business outcomes.

Success means more than delivering a configured system. It means making sound solution decisions, reducing implementation complexity, ensuring consistent quality and helping customers realise lasting value from Autorola's software solutions.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Lead the analysis and translation of complex customer requirements and business processes into effective, scalable solution designs.

• Take ownership of the technical and functional solution approach throughout customer engagements, from initial assessment to implementation and validation.

• Design, configure and build Autorola software solutions, ensuring that they meet business needs and align with product capabilities, architecture and standards.

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements and recommending solutions that balance business value, feasibility and long-term sustainability.

• Provide senior solution input during project scoping, including technical effort estimates, dependency assessments, risk identification and evaluation of alternative approaches.

• Work closely with Project Management Consultants to ensure that solution decisions support realistic plans, predictable delivery and successful customer outcomes.

• Assess the fit between customer-specific requirements and standard product functionality, identifying when configuration, process adaptation or new development is the most appropriate approach.

• Collaborate with Product Management and Software Development (ASYS) to shape, clarify and qualify enhancement requests and development requirements.

• Take responsibility for solution quality, including configuration standards, test planning, validation and the resolution of functional and technical issues.

• Support customers' operational teams in adopting new solutions and ensuring that implemented functionality works effectively in their day-to-day business.

• Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, solution consistency and reuse through templates, standards, guidelines and proven practices.

• Act as a senior sparring partner and knowledge resource for colleagues, supporting the development of solution expertise and promoting knowledge sharing across the organisation.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our consulting methods, delivery processes and collaboration across Business System Consulting, Project Management, Product Management and Software Development.

**Who are we looking for?

**We're looking for an experienced Senior Business System Consultant who combines strong business acumen with substantial solution consulting experience, sound technical judgement and the ability to guide customers and colleagues through complex implementation challenges.

You can move confidently between business processes, product capabilities and technical considerations. You know how to challenge requirements constructively, make informed trade-offs and turn complexity into clear, actionable solution designs.

**You Likely Have

**

• Several years of relevant experience in business systems consulting, solution consulting, software implementation, business process consultancy or a similar client-facing role.

• A proven track record of leading or taking significant ownership of complex system implementations and solution designs.

• Strong experience translating complex business requirements into practical, scalable and maintainable software solutions.

• Extensive experience with system configuration, functional design, testing and implementation quality.

• The ability to assess solution alternatives, evaluate technical and functional trade-offs, and make well-founded recommendations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and pragmatic approach to decision-making.

• The confidence to advise customers, challenge assumptions and communicate complex topics clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

• Experience collaborating with Project Management, Software Development, Product Management and other cross-functional teams.

• The ability to identify implementation risks, dependencies and opportunities early, helping create more predictable and efficient delivery.

• A continuous improvement mindset and an interest in developing shared standards, best practices and team capabilities.

• The ability to balance individual customer needs with standard functionality, product consistency and long-term maintainability.

• A willingness to travel internationally for customer engagements when required.

Experience with enterprise software, IT consulting, Agile environments or the automotive industry is an advantage. Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to the development of consulting practices is also beneficial.

**What Success Looks Like

**Within your first 12–18 months, you'll have:

• Established yourself as a trusted senior advisor to customers on complex business processes, solution design and product capabilities.

• Successfully led the solution design and technical delivery of complex customer implementations.

• Built a strong understanding of Autorola's products, business processes, technical capabilities and strategic priorities.

• Helped Project Management Consultants scope customer engagements more accurately through sound technical assessments, effort estimates and early risk identification.

• Improved solution quality, consistency and maintainability through clear design principles and well-founded technical and functional decisions.

• Strengthened collaboration between customers, Business System Consulting, Project Management, Software Development (ASYS), Product Management, Sales and our subsidiaries.

• Contributed to more efficient implementations through reusable solutions, improved templates, standards and best practices.

• Shared your experience and expertise to strengthen the capabilities of the wider consulting team.

• Helped customers adopt their solutions successfully and realise measurable value in their day-to-day operations.

**Why join Autorola Group?

**Autorola Group is a global company with more than 850 employees across 20 subsidiaries in Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

At Autorola Solutions, you'll join an international environment where project management, business process expertise and software development come together to solve complex challenges for leading automotive companies.

As a Senior Business System Consultant, you'll have a significant influence on how we design and deliver customer solutions. You'll work across organisational and geographical boundaries, collaborate with experienced colleagues and help shape the standards, methods and practices that support our continued growth.

We also offer pension and health insurance, social and company events, a great lunch arrangement, access to a fitness room and a lively Friday bar.

**Want to join the team?

**We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that this description reflects our ideal candidate profile. We strongly believe in inclusion and diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

Applications and CVs will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the advertisement may be removed once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Christian Gless, Tech Talent Acquisition Partner, at csg@autorola.com.

We store summer sun for the winter. Now Photoncycle is heading into thousands of Danish homes, and we are looking for a trainee who wants to help build the market from the ground up. Is that you?

About Photoncycle

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store the energy in a tank in the ground next to the house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system.

We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

Photoncycle is a completely new technology, and Denmark is our first market.

Why this role

As a trainee, you will be part of building Photoncycle's Danish operations, from research and permit processes to partner dialogues, pilot customers and events. You will work across the full breadth of a market launch and get hands-on experience with how a new energy technology is brought to market in Denmark.

The role is deliberately broad, and the scope will be tailored to the number of hours you work. Tasks will shift as the launch gets closer, and your responsibilities will grow with the role down the line.

What you will do

This is a versatile, hands-on role that mixes research, relationships and the nuts-and-bolts work. You will report to Anne Clara Laugesen, General Manager of Photoncycle Denmark, and work closely with our colleagues in Oslo.

Tasks and responsibility will include:

Market build and operations support

• 
Support our pilot customer programme, from first contact to onboarding

• 
Follow and assist with permit processes and dialogues with municipalities and authorities

• 
Help build and maintain relationships with customers, partners and stakeholders

• 
Take part in preparing test sites and the first installations

Research and analysis

• 
Desk research on municipalities, funding schemes, partners and competitors

• 
Monitor funding and grant opportunities

• 
Collect and structure data and recurring customer questions for internal use

Events and meetings

• 
Practical planning of customer meetings, community events and site visits: invitations, sign-ups, venue, catering and follow-up

• 
Prepare material and logistics for conferences and external events the team attends

What you bring

We imagine you being structured and comfortable juggling many small tasks at once. You take ownership, spot what needs to be done, and ask when something is unclear.

We expect you to:

• 
Be studying, or recently graduated, in a relevant field such as business, energy, engineering, public administration or similar

• 
Write and speak Danish fluently and work comfortably in English

• 
Be confident with Office tools and quick to pick up new systems

• 
Handle confidential information, including customer data, with care

It is a plus if you:

• 
Have an interest in the energy transition, energy systems or the Danish energy market

• 
Have experience from a startup, student job or association work with admin or coordination

• 
Are used to working with AI tools

You don't need to be an energy expert. What matters most is that you enjoy building something new where the right answer isn't known yet – so apply even if you can't tick every box.

What we offer

• 
A front-row seat to building a new energy company in Denmark ahead of a 2027 launch

• 
Close daily collaboration with the GM and real responsibility from day one

• 
Insight into regulation, permits, partnerships and go-to-market in the energy sector

• 
A small, international team with colleagues in Norway

• 
An office in the heart of Copenhagen at BloxHub, with a great lunch setup and free coffee

Start and application

The position can be set up in three ways: as a paid student job (15–37 hours a week), as an internship as part of your studies, or as virksomhedspraktik via your jobcentre if you have recently graduated and are currently unemployed. Hours and tasks are tailored to the arrangement. The start date is yesterday – or whenever you're ready, really.

We will be taking interviews as applications come in.

Photoncycle is committed to an inclusive workplace and hires based on skills, experience and potential. We encourage everyone interested to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnic background, religion or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

🤩 **About the role

**We are looking for an AI Engineer to build the AI layer of All Gravy: agents that plan shifts, answer manager questions, and take real actions across 2,000+ hospitality and retail locations in the Nordics and UK.

This is a build role, not a research role. You will ship agents that customers use in production, then own how well they work. We are looking for someone who has already built and shipped AI agents and who is relentlessly curious about what just became possible. The field moves faster than any roadmap, so part of the job is noticing the new capability before anyone asks you to, testing it, and telling us whether it changes what we should build.

🎯 **What you will do

**

• Build agent harnesses. Design and ship agents that call internal and external tools to solve real customer problems, both interactively with users and autonomously in the background.

• Own the eval loop. Build the harnesses, datasets, and offline and online evals that tell us whether an agent got better or worse. You define what "working" means and you defend the number.

• Ship full stack. Take features end to end, from the manager and employee interfaces where schedules are built and shifts are picked up, through the backend services and data layers that power them.

• Run it in production. Own latency, cost, failure modes, and guardrails for the agents you ship. When one misbehaves at 6am on a Saturday, you are the person who understands why.

• Investigate what is new. Try the new models, frameworks, and techniques as they land, build small things to find out where they actually hold up, and bring back a clear read on what we should adopt and what we should ignore.

• Work across teams. Partner with product and the other engineering teams so AI features fit the wider All Gravy ecosystem, and contribute to shared standards and architectural decisions.

✅ **What we are looking for

**

• You have built agents that shipped to real users, not just demos. You can talk through what broke, what you changed, and what you would do differently.

• Genuine curiosity, evidenced by things you built. You have side projects, throwaway experiments, or strong opinions formed by actually running the thing rather than reading about it.

• Strong context and prompt engineering, including retrieval, tool design, and structured outputs. You know why an agent fails and it is usually not the model.

• Solid production engineering in TypeScript and Node.js, or the ability to get there fast from another typed language.

• Comfort reading and writing code, reviewing architecture, and working directly with infrastructure. You ship the fix rather than filing the ticket.

• Judgment about when an agent is the right answer and when a well placed SQL query or a boring deterministic rule is better.

🙌 **You'll thrive here if you

**We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning

• 5+ years of proven full-stack experience across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.

• Ability to design and architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems.

• Startup or scale-up background. You know what it means to move fast, make pragmatic calls, and revisit them when the time is right.

• Fluent English, spoken and written.

• Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.

An advantage if you have experience in:

• Vercel AI SDK

• Mastra or similar Agent framework

💎 **Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• Top equipment. You'll receive all new equipment to do your best work

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

💡 Even if you do not tick every box on this page, you might be the perfect fit for the job! We treasure our learning culture and encourage all humble people to apply.

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.
